# Sales Order Analysis: January to June 2026

**Method:** Each order's value is quantity × unit price × (1 − discount%). Net revenue includes only orders with status "Completed".

## Q1: Net revenue in March 2026

There were 13 completed orders in March:

1,083 + 798 + 665 + 1,653 + 409.50 + 110.50 + 325 + 307.80 + 1,515.25 + 720 + 190 + 1,680 + 1,083 = **£10,540.05**

## Q2: Region with the highest net revenue in Q2

| Region | Q2 Net Revenue |
|---|---|
| **West** | **£10,871.20** |
| East | £7,744.55 |
| South | £6,830.25 |
| North | £971.35 |
| **Total** | **£26,417.35** |

## Q3: Product with the largest percentage growth from Q1 to Q2

| Product | Q1 | Q2 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Desk Lamp** | £1,299.60 | £3,028.60 | **+133.04%** |
| Monitor Arm | £4,722.25 | £6,266.00 | +32.69% |
| Desk Chair | £8,895.75 | £5,756.50 | −35.3% |
| Filing Cabinet | £11,817.00 | £5,274.00 | −55.4% |
| Standing Desk | £7,812.00 | £2,772.00 | −64.5% |
| Whiteboard | £11,499.75 | £3,320.25 | −71.1% |

The product totals add up to the Q1 total of £46,046.35 and the Q2 total of £26,417.35, which matches the regional figures.
